notes.title: The Christmas Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey, Shavers! 👋

❄️ The Christmas Update is Live! ❄️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/91aae07562064e7e758261f19a458521d7d737f3.png

There’s a unique red door on the main menu waiting for you! Inside, you’ll find some familiar faces who need your skills this holiday season:

🎅 Santa Claus:: Make sure he’s ready to deliver all those gifts!
🧝  Elf: Help himlook their best to keep Santa in good spirits!
👵 Mrs. Claus: Give her a fresh new look for the festivities!

Join our Discord server to share your best creations, chat with other players, and take part in fun events for a chance to win exclusive merch!

Have fun, and Merry Christmas from all of us! 🎄✨

notes.title: Full Release on Steam ---> the 13th of November!
notes.notes:
Hello there, Shavers!

It is time to share the full release date on Steam for Shave & Stuff!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/fe31eed389309076e4ceaa3b104a8ee0c9e10b26.png

FULL RELEASE —> 13th of November!

Take on the role of a barber and tattoo master. Set your imagination free, use the tools of your trade to fulfill your client’s needs, or just have raw creative fun! Become the master of the new look! 

Remember to join our great community on Discord Server where you will be able to participate in various of events and win exciting prizes!

Thank you for all the support, and we hope you will have a lot of fun playing Shave & Stuff on Steam!


~Shave & Stuff Team

notes.title: FADES UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Good Morning, Barbers!

We know that you have been asking for this update for a while… Shave & Stuff presents
- FADES!!! 🚀

Yes, you heard that right! 👏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/107336e82f4d3ec3af8f16cd6a7d94dc02857d65.png



Now, show off your creativity without any restrictions! Give some top-notch fades to your customers without compromising on style! It’s time for you to unleash your skills and give them the look they’ve been craving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/b466cf972e061b0774fa1ab7e16aa10f4006d6e1.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/169aae32004aecd00824dc2f58b2387a77bed3b9.gif

It’s worth mentioning that we have tweaked the trimmer and now, it’s trimming hair where it's actually placed! 🥳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/de6cc8f7492638e3b6c120663bcaeca9e743f1a9.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/8a44a401d314ec96c2614c53d9cdb9754ec83b08.gif


Thanks for all feedback! 🙌🏻💪🏻


So what are you waiting for? Let’s have some fun and dive into the world of endless possibilities and endless styles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339064/45deeca2187d3596b7da4e0cc8cb902b9774cf85.gif

Don’t forget to check out our Official Shave & Stuff Fades trailer on YouTube!

[previewyoutube=AKoCkCV3uQk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you once again for all the love and support!

Happy Barbering! 🪒

- Dev Team
